details.description: Discover the unique and delightful taste of Bovonto, a carbonated soft drink that offers a perfect balance of classic sweetness and a captivating flavour profile. Crafted with the finest ingredients, Bovonto combines fruity notes with a hint of spices, creating a refreshing and fizzy drinking experience that is perfect for quenching your thirst on a hot day or enjoying as a special treat. Close your eyes and experience the happiness that comes from the perfect balance of fizziness and authentic flavour. Bovonto is a beverage that stands out from the rest, offering a delightful and memorable drinking experience that your guests will love. Whether you're looking to enjoy it on its own or as part of a gathering, one glass of Bovonto is never enough.
details.ingredients: Carbonated Water, Sugar, Citric Acid E330, And Contains Permitted Natural Colour 150D And Synthetic Food Colour E133, 122, 124, 102, Contain Permitted Class Ii Preservatives E211
details.storageInstructions:
*Store in a cool and dry place
*Tastes best when chilled
